entries.text: We offer premium business solutions including consulting, digital transformation, and managed services. Our clients typically see 30% improvement in operational efficiency within the first quarter.
Our pricing is customized based on business size and needs. We offer flexible monthly plans starting from competitive rates with no long-term contracts required. Volume discounts available.
When a lead says it's too expensive, emphasize ROI and value. Mention our money-back guarantee and flexible payment plans. Share case studies showing 3x return on investment within 6 months.
When a lead says it's not the right time, acknowledge their situation and offer to schedule a future follow-up. Mention limited-time offers or seasonal promotions that create gentle urgency.
When a lead is using a competitor, don't badmouth the competition. Instead, highlight our unique differentiators: 24/7 support, dedicated account manager, and proprietary technology stack.
When a lead needs internal approval, offer to provide a business case document or ROI calculator they can share with decision-makers. Offer to join a call with their team.
When a lead had a bad past experience, sincerely apologize and explain improvements made since then. Offer a risk-free trial or pilot program to rebuild trust.
When a lead has no budget, discuss payment flexibility and phased implementation. Show how our solution can actually reduce costs in other areas, making it budget-neutral.
When a lead thinks the solution is too complex, emphasize our white-glove onboarding process, dedicated support team, and intuitive interface. Offer a personalized demo.
When a lead is happy with their current solution, respect their satisfaction but plant seeds about future needs. Mention emerging trends and how our platform is positioned for them.

Our brand voice is professional yet approachable. We avoid aggressive sales tactics, pressure language, or false urgency. Every message should feel like it's from a trusted advisor, not a salesperson.

All SMS messages must comply with TCPA regulations. Every message must provide an opt-out mechanism. Never send messages outside business hours (9 AM - 5 PM local time). Maximum one message per lead per day.
Best follow-up cadence: first touch at day 1, second touch at day 3, third touch at day 7. After 3 touches with no response, escalate to human review. Never send more than 3 unreturned messages.
High intent signals: visited pricing page, downloaded whitepaper, attended webinar, requested demo, engaged with email campaigns. These leads should receive priority follow-up within 24 hours.
Lead scoring factors: recency of interaction (40%), engagement level (25%), company size (15%), industry fit (10%), and source quality (10%). Leads scoring above 70 are high priority.
Current promotions: Q1 early bird discount (15% off annual plans), free onboarding for new clients, and extended 60-day trial for enterprise accounts. Use these as re-engagement hooks.
Case study: TechCorp reduced operational costs by 40% and increased team productivity by 25% within 3 months of implementing our solution. Their CTO called it a game-changer.
Case study: RetailMax saw a 50% increase in customer retention and 35% growth in repeat purchases after deploying our customer engagement platform.
When a lead is concerned about data security, highlight our SOC 2 Type II certification, GDPR compliance, end-to-end encryption, and annual third-party security audits.
When a lead is worried about integration complexity, mention our pre-built connectors for 200+ tools, REST API, dedicated integration support team, and typical 2-week setup time.
